answers.explanation: The proposal follows the required sequential bootstrap: introduce ADR-001 with its substantive, self-contained architecture update, verify and obtain independent semantic review, and commit before starting ADR-002. Acceptance is of the proposed process, not evidence that implementation, review, or delivery has already occurred; resulting main commits must preserve these separate delivery units.
